newsitem.title: USA: CERBCO sees higher Capitol Copy results.
newsitem.headline: CERBCO sees higher Capitol Copy results.

text.p: CERBCO Inc said on Friday it expects continued favorable results in the year ending June 1997 at its Capitol Copy Products Inc unit, but its Insituform East Inc is expected to have less favorable results in the first quarter.
The company said it believes that anticipated increases in Insituform East's backlog should result in favorable results over the remaining three quarters of fiscal 1997.
In the year ended June 1996, the company reported profits of $2.1 million, or $1.40 a share, on sales of $55.7 million.
